summary: No agency page: the Lolo NF camping list and its Superior Area page (Cabin City, Deer Creek, Little Joe, Quartz Flat, Peninsula dispersed...) do not include Missoula Lake, no fs.usda.gov slug for it resolves, and recreation.gov has no facility. Visit Montana has only a Missoula Lake TRAIL listing (mentions camping spots near the lake, no campground detail). Google Maps lists 'Missoula Lake Campground' (Campground, Forest Rd 320, Superior) with 1 review (5.0, 'a year ago', no text) and no phone. Nothing written; derived facilities/FCFS left. Superior RD phone 406-822-4233 matches the entry.
flags: No agency or official tourism page for this campground: the Lolo NF's own campground lists (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/camping-cabins, https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/superior-area) do not include it and recreation.gov has no facility. Google Maps lists it as a campground but with no phone and only one rating with no text (a year ago), so neither a phone nor a recent review confirms overnight camping. The entry's website is the generic Lolo camping list. Criteria question (presence); access is ~24 mi of gravel up Cedar Creek Rd (FR 320) per Visit Montana's Missoula Lake Trail listing.
